newsitem.title: JAPAN: NTT shares higher on restructuring plans.
newsitem.headline: NTT shares higher on restructuring plans.

text.p: Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp (NTT) shares were higher in Monday morning trade as investors continued to buy on the news of the plans to restructure the telephone giant, brokers said.
As of 0155 GMT, the shares were 21,000 yen higher at 866,000 yen.
"The market appreciates the news that current shareholders' rights will not be altered after the restructuring is carried out," a broker at a second-tier brokerage said.
Other market sources said NTT is seen as the core of the telecommunications sector and investors hope that it will lead the sector.
On Friday, NTT said the company would be reorganised into a holding company supervising the operations of three major units -- two regional companies and a long-distance carrier.
